about: The one queue of open work for Polymechania (and its Gnomon blockers). Source of truth: edit this file, then run `python bench/workqueue.py` to render docs/queue.md. Fields: id, title, kind (test|build|fix|doc|infra|decision), status (open|in-progress|blocked|waiting-owner|scheduled|parked|done), needs (free|api|pro|owner|people), cost (API $ estimate, 0 if free), value (high|medium|low: how much it could change a decision), blocked_by (ids), next (the next concrete step), refs.
